conditions: Each value must also be <= the actual device-visible hardware limit; virtual devices or masked cores can lower availability.

Some kernels use fewer cores or runtime fallback/tiling policies; compilation success alone does not prove every operator uses the requested ceiling.
vir_type_list=2,3,6,12,24 in the platform file describes virtual types; it is not the allowed-list for ge.aicoreNum values.
